title: Selected Work
subtitle: AI workflows shipped, agentic prototyping consumed by engineering, design systems as deployed APIs — selected for DAYONE

application.positioning: AI-Workflow-Architect · High-Speed Agentic Building · Solution Engineering · Tech-Enabler

selection_rationale.bibeltv-agentic-engineering: Primary positioning hook. Direct hit on DAYONE's 'High-Speed Product Design & Building with AI-IDEs' + 'Rapid Iteration' + 'Tech-Enabler' pillars. Claude Code, real Bibel TV APIs, engineering consumes prototype code directly, days-to-hours iteration shift, team-wide evangelism of vibe-coded prototyping as design practice. This is the story DAYONE is hiring for.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-design-system-api: Solution Engineering anchor. Verbatim parallel to the JD's 'technologische Abkürzungen für komplexe Business-Probleme' framing. Concrete shipped infrastructure (Git + Style Dictionary + DTCG standard + automated CI sync) replacing four-platforms-drifting-apart copy-paste, without a platform-engineering team. Also proves Technisches Fundament (APIs, structured data).
selection_rationale.bibeltv-support-agent: AI-Workflow-Architect anchor. Production agent workflow with handbook-as-runtime-context, human-in-the-loop send decision treated as a design point, escalation as a first-class output. Executive format keeps the surface tight — the two in-depth slots are spent on agentic-engineering and design-system-api; this is the third anchor in compressed form.
selection_rationale.ninox-ai-onboarding: Second AI proof and the most directly user-facing AI design story. Vibe-coding prompt-to-database with split-screen direct manipulation; user agency preservation in AI systems. Reinforces AI-Native Mindset + Product/Interface Focus. Browseable rather than featured because Bibel TV is the current role and carries more JD-aligned signal.
selection_rationale.churchdesk-booking-system: Speed + measurable-impact proof for any reader wanting quantitative evidence. 2-month delivery, 70% coordination-time reduction, 90% acceptance via smart filtering. Engineering built directly from design in React / React Native — non-AI design-to-shipped-software chops underneath the agentic ones. Executive format because the in-depth narrative is long and the AI angle (AI alt-text) is downstream of the main story.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-ai-prototyping: Hidden — substantially overlaps bibeltv-agentic-engineering. Hidden to avoid surfacing two near-duplicate stories in the DAYONE view. Also: status 'in-progress' with known AI-slop concerns from earlier reviews; out of scope to fix here.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-color-api: Hidden — craft-depth proof (OKLCH, k-means brand-color extraction) but narrower fit for an AI-builder role. Risks over-weighting Bibel TV in the surface.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-app-redesign: Hidden — growth + competitive-strategy + design-system angle is good but narrower DAYONE fit; the agentic-engineering and design-system-API case studies already cover the Bibel TV technical depth.
selection_rationale.ninox-org-building: Hidden — actively anti-aligned with the JD framing. The brief explicitly says: position Tobias as a hands-on AI builder, not as an org leader looking for headcount. Surfacing this story would muddy the positioning. Kept available behind ?all for any reader who goes deep on leadership history.
selection_rationale.datameer-data-dense-analytics: Hidden — the CV references the 5-year Datameer director tenure as the technical-foundation anchor; the portfolio surface stays focused on AI / agentic / studio-relevant work. Kept for ?all readers going deep on the enterprise / data-dense / regulated background.
selection_rationale.spreadshirt-user-research-strategy: Hidden — 2014-16, predates AI-era work entirely; not DAYONE-domain-adjacent. ChurchDesk is the more current strategic-influence anchor for any reader who wants one.

gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.n8n_workflow_in_production: Per brief Gap 1 and verification log: no production n8n deployment. The four Bibel TV n8n workflows are documentation-only today. Aperto Bible-translation n8n workflow is being built personally this week as builder-signal. Acknowledged honestly in the cover letter ('two AI workflows shipped on Copilot-skill infrastructure at Bibel TV, not n8n; transferable orchestration practice; would pick up n8n on the first project'). Once the Aperto workflow ships, surfaces as a cover-letter reference + screenshot, not as a portfolio case study.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.cursor_windsurf_specific: Per brief Gap 2 and verification log: Claude Code is the verified daily AI-IDE; Cursor and Windsurf are not named in any verified source. Cover letter reframes honestly ('Claude Code is my daily agentic-coding tool — Cursor and Windsurf are the same shape of tool; I'd move between them quickly'). No fabricated Cursor/Windsurf case study.
